<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Museum and scheme approvals:</strong> The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has approved a $340 million (Rs 3,230 crore) project for the Yug Yugeen Bharat National Museum in Delhi and extended the Stand-Up India scheme until 2031 to support SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
